title: Fresh Flower Pot 32×
description: Detailed flower pots with vanilla-friendly designs and more variety
body:
![Fresh flower pot 32×](https://i.postimg.cc/053LFGTM/file-00000000c4b471fa8e9eda219ecf543f.png)
Fresh Flower Pots gives flower pots a fresh look by adding new models based on the plant inside. The pack also introduces different soil types, along with other tweaks and fixes.

# All Potted Plants
![FLOWER POT](https://i.postimg.cc/q7yR6M2m/601aaa04-bf12-4cef-8cff-87a3e3bcfbb1.png)
### Features
Variation:Depending on the plant, the flower pot has a different model and soil. There are 5 different flower pots and 11 different soil types!

### Optimization:
The pack is extremely lightweight, with the new models having almost no impact on performance and even rendering slightly faster compared to vanilla in some cases.

### Compatibility:
The pack is compatible with all other resource packs that don't alter the models of potted plants. For optimal compatibility, ensure that Fresh Flower Pots is loaded above any other resource packs.

• New flower pot item texture 32×

• No dirt in empty flower pots

• Fixed several lighting-related issues and inconsistencies with flower pots

• Fixed flower pot breaking particles
